snippet.title: MacGyvered Projects & Prepping
snippet.description:
MacGyvered Prepping is about everyday problem-solving, improvised projects, and making things work when they don’t want to. I thrive on learning as I go.

I’m just a regular guy MacGyvering power, communications, electronics, gear, and practical prepper projects — along with random fixes and builds around the house. I share what works, what doesn’t, and everything I learn along the way.

When the world breaks, we MacGyver it.
It’s the ultimate DIY — not always pretty, not always professional, but it works… and that’s the goal.

Preparedness isn’t about panic, it’s about adaptability.

Something is coming...  However, no matter what happens, God wins in the end.

snippet.title: PrepLogic
snippet.description: Welcome to your practical guide to emergency preparedness, home survival, and reliable backup gear. This channel helps everyday families prepare for power outages, severe storms, water shortages, roadside emergencies, and unexpected disruptions without fear, hype, or extreme prepping. We test and compare portable power stations, solar generators, emergency radios, water filters, rechargeable lights, first aid kits, car survival tools, food storage solutions, and other useful products available online. Each video focuses on real situations, clear explanations, honest product insights, and simple steps you can use before an emergency happens. Whether you are building a 72-hour kit, preparing for a two-week blackout, protecting your apartment, or creating a family emergency plan, you will find practical ideas that fit real homes and real budgets.

snippet.title: Andrew Thomas Price
snippet.description:
Join Andrew Thomas Price—broadcaster, writer, wilderness skills instructor, and naturalist—as he delves into the world of bushcraft, survival techniques, and the rich tapestry of Welsh nature. Based in the scenic landscapes of Gower, Wales, Andrew shares his expertise through engaging videos that cover:

Practical survival strategies and emergency preparedness

Traditional crafts and ancient skills

Foraging insights and unique recipes featuring wild ingredients

In-depth gear reviews and comparisons

Explorations of Welsh folklore and natural history

Whether you're an outdoor enthusiast, a survivalist, or someone curious about nature's wonders, Andrew's channel offers a wealth of knowledge and inspiration. Subscribe to embark on a journey of discovery and self-reliance in the great outdoors.

Like, comment and subscribe to keep me motivated to make more content and it's nice to watch more than just one video, I have so many. snippet.title: Grillin With Dad
snippet.description:
My name is Maciek and I'm a backyard grill guy, cooking for my family and friends. Originally from Poland, I had my first taste of American BBQ at age 10. And let's just say I was immediately hooked! 

In 2017 my loving wife bought me a Big Green Egg for Father's Day. I decided to do what every 35 year old guy does when he gets a new grill. I started an Instagram page to share my dishes with the world. Well, maybe not everyone... What started as a fun hobby has grown into a full blown passion. Cooking, grilling and sharing my easy grilling recipes with others is what this page is all about. 

I make easy meals that anyone can replicate at home. I'm not a professionally trained chef, just your average guy that likes to fire up the grill. 

So follow along and see what's cooking today!

snippet.title: MRE's World
snippet.description:
MRE's World proudly offers Genuine U.S. Military MRE's (Meals Ready-to-Eat) – trusted by service members and now available for your emergency and outdoor needs.

Each case is certified by inspection and includes a Fresh-Check Indicator, ensuring it has been properly stored for maximum freshness and shelf life.

These military-grade meals are designed for:

✅ Emergency preparedness & survival kits
✅ Camping, hiking, and outdoor adventures
✅ Reliable, no-cook meal solutions
✅ Each case weighs approximately 20lbs and contains a variety of complete, ready-to-eat meals with balanced nutrition 
✅ No refrigeration or cooking required.

Whether you're preparing for the unexpected or stocking up for outdoor trips, MRE's World, military MRE's deliver the quality, convenience, and durability you can count on. Authentic MRE

snippet.title: The Ready Life
snippet.description:
Get our free weekly updates: ↓↓↓ LINK BELOW ↓↓↓

Hi!  We are Nick & Lisa Meissner and we live deep in the mountains with our young family.  We think it's a really bad idea to depend on huge corporations or government entities for your basic necessities of life (like water, heat, and food)!  We're also Christians and believe this kind of dependence will be used to control everyone as part of the end times.

That's why we have dedicated our lives to helping YOU become as independent as possible for basic necessities.  So you are never again faced with being at the mercy of the government or corporate entities for your ability to survive.  Once we've done that, we can be part of the solution for others by preparing to share.

So come along with us and make our journey your own...Let's do this thing!

PS - As an Amazon Associate, I earn from qualifying purchases. It won't cost you any extra and helps support the channel.

snippet.title: Primitive Survival Craft
snippet.description:
Welcome to "Primitive Survival Craft"

This is a place to keep footage of survival journeys and exploring the wild nature. Here, we share the process of building tents, houses, and shelters using natural materials such as soil, wood, stone, forest leaves... all done by hand, without using modern machinery.

Each construction is not only a place to live, but also a testament to ingenuity, patience and the ability to harmonize with nature. From simple earthen houses, cozy fireplaces in the forest, to solid constructions against storms and wild animals, all bring a sense of peace, closeness and inspire survival.

The channel is not only for those who love bushcraft, survival skills, but also for those who want to relax, find peace in the rustling of the wind, the sound of falling rain, and pristine natural scenery.

👉 Sign up and join us on this journey to discover the connection between humans and wildlife!

Subscribe to Smart Stockpile Pantry and learn how to stock smart, spend less, and stay prepared.

snippet.title: Pi Fire Science & Emergency Response
snippet.description:
Pi Fire Science covers disasters, emergency response, and public safety, with a focus on the amazing people responding when things go wrong.

Since 2013, we’ve worked with fire departments and emergency response organizations to capture training, operations, incidents, and the people behind the work.

Today, that work has expanded to significant disasters and emergency events around the world. Through original reporting, real-world footage, and carefully researched coverage, we provide factual context as events unfold.

Our goal is to present these events responsibly and in context, with an emphasis on public understanding and education rather than sensationalism.

Stay up-to-date by visiting https://pifirescience.com
